name: Dibujando un corazón roto
source:
A spin-off of "los guerreros legendarios de los tálismanes", this story follows Esmeralda—a high school student who is in love with a classmate. She signs up for a drawing workshop held at her school during the holidays. There are various endings—good ones, bad ones, and some truly gruesome ones—the choice is yours.

[Translated from [url=https://seityposa.itch.io/dibujando-un-corazon-roto]Itch.io[/url]]
